real_qa.q: What are the key interface adaptations Apple made to macOS for the new ProLED XDR MacBook Pro touchscreen?
real_qa.r: Apple adapted Mac OS for touch targets by focusing on key elements like buttons, stepwise controllers with up and down arrow buttons positioned above and below the finger, sliders with quality touch targets, and radial dials that expand their touch angle radius when touched. The operating system gets out of the way as the touch target appears, and there is an accessibility setting to turn off the touchscreen entirely if needed.
real_qa.requete: macOS touch interface ProLED XDR adaptations

real_qa.q: What are the weight reductions on the new M5 Max MacBook Pro with ProLED XDR compared to previous models?
real_qa.r: The 14-inch MacBook Pro shaves half a pound (approximately 250 grams) off the weight, while the 16-inch MacBook Pro loses a whole pound (approximately 500 grams), making it lighter and more portable than the previous generation.
real_qa.requete: M5 Max MacBook Pro weight reduction

real_qa.q: What is the starting price and primary use case for the new iPad mini with OLED display?
real_qa.r: The new iPad mini with OLED display starts at $800 US, and is particularly popular as an electronic flight bag for pilots. The OLED screen provides the bright display needed for flight decks, while the compact size and on-device AI capabilities allow pilots to quickly query aircraft manuals and procedure manuals rather than carrying paper maps.
real_qa.requete: iPad mini OLED price electronic flight bag

real_qa.q: What is the iMac Ethernet port upgrade from the M6 generation?
real_qa.r: The Ethernet port on the new M6 iMac, which is built into the power brick, has been upgraded from a one-gigabit port to a two-and-a-half gigabit port, matching the upgrade that was previously made to the Mac mini.
real_qa.requete: iMac M6 Ethernet port upgrade 2.5 gig

real_qa.q: Why does the new MacBook Pro ProLED XDR have a touchscreen despite not being designed around touch capabilities?
real_qa.r: According to rumors, the touchscreen was engineered into the system primarily because it was actually easier and more affordable to source OLED displays with a touch layer already built into them, rather than the touchscreen being a core design requirement for the operating system.
real_qa.requete: ProLED XDR touchscreen OLED cost engineering
